incident_updates.body: We’re seeing recovery for a large percentage of affected customers, though some issues remain in certain regions. We’re continuing to work on resolving the remaining issues and will share further updates as more information becomes available.

We’ve added extra capacity to the system and are currently testing it. We expect to begin stabilizing the affected clusters shortly. We’ll continue to share further updates as more information becomes available.

We are continuing to investigate increased Realtime latency and instability affecting the presence feature, which may impact join rates. Our team is actively working on mitigation and we will share another update as soon as more information becomes available.

We’re seeing increased Realtime latency and instability affecting the presence feature, which may impact join rates. This recurrence comes as we continue work on the remaining preventative measures. We are actively investigating and taking steps to mitigate the impact. We’ll share another update as soon as we have more information.
We have taken preventative steps to expand our realtime cluster capacity and are continuing to monitor our system stability for full recovery.
We have identified the cause and taken actions to remediate the high latency issues. We will continue to monitor.
We are experiencing increased latency with Realtime and are actively investigating.

We will be carrying out a scheduled maintenance window to perform internal platform improvements and upgrades.

Maintenance Window:

• Start time: 03:00 UTC on July 2, 2026

• End time: 04:00 UTC on July 2, 2026

Impact:

• Various platform operations will be delayed during this window

• These may include project creation and initial configuration/setup

• All affected operations will be rescheduled at the end of the window to ensure no operation is dropped
